title: The Space Ship
lines: Jane and Ben make a space ship.
Jane and Ben use a box and tape.
Jane picks a place on the grass.
Ben has a big grin on his face.
Jane and Ben race and hop in.
The ship is not fast. It is a box.
But Jane and Ben can be in space!

questions.ask: What do Jane and Ben use to make the ship?
questions.listenFor: A big box and tape. It is stated in the story, so have them find the line.

questions.ask: Does the ship really fly? How do you know?
questions.listenFor: No. The story says it is not fast, it is a box. Listen for them using that line as the reason.

questions.ask: Where do you think their ship goes? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Anything imaginative counts. You want a because, like "to the moon, because they said it was space."
